verdict.rationale: Datalab is a document-processing SaaS with an SDK, CLI, and on-prem containers, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out setting for the SDK, CLI, or hosted service. Paid air-gapped on-prem deployment and BAA/DPA terms are related privacy offerings, but they do not show that users can turn off telemetry.
